title: Varifold tangents 8.5.1–5.4 (corrected 5.2, 5.3) and the blow-up density lower bound used in 5.5/5.7
statement: (A, Simon 8.5.1–5.4 corrected) If V has locally bounded first variation in U, x ∈ U, θ0 > 0, Θ^n(μ_V,x) = θ0 and ρ^{1−n}‖δV‖(B_ρ(x)) → 0 as ρ ↓ 0, then every sequence λ_j > 0, λ_j → 0 has a subsequence along which the rescalings V_{x,λ_j} = rescaledMeasure V x λ_j converge vaguely (against C_c(ℝ^N × G)) to some n-varifold C on ℝ^N; and every such limit C (IsVarifoldTangent V x C) is stationary in ℝ^N, satisfies μ_C(B_ρ(0)) = θ0 ω_n ρ^n for all ρ > 0, and μ_C(sA) = s^n μ_C(A) for all s > 0 and A ⊆ ℝ^N (this is VarifoldTangentCones). (B, the use of 3.7 in 5.5 and 5.7) If V has locally bounded first variation, x ∈ U, τ > 0, ρ^{1−n}‖δV‖(B_ρ(x)) → 0 and ρ^{-n}μ_V({y ∈ B_ρ(x) : not (Θ^n(μ_V,y) exists and ≥ τ)}) → 0 as ρ ↓ 0, then for every varifold tangent C of V at x, Θ^n(μ_C,y) exists and is ≥ τ for μ_C-a.e. y.
lean_statement: VarifoldTangentCones ∧ ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (τ : ℝ), V.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation → x ∈ U → 0 < τ → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ ENNReal.ofReal ρ * variationMeasure V (closedBall x ρ) / ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ V.weight {y | y ∈ closedBall x ρ ∧ ¬ ∃ θ : ℝ≥0∞, HasDensity n V.weight y θ ∧ ENNReal.ofReal τ ≤ θ} / ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → ∀ C : Varifold N n (univ : Set (Euclidean N)), IsVarifoldTangent V x C → ∀ᵐ y ∂C.weight, ∃ θ : ℝ≥0∞, HasDensity n C.weight y θ ∧ ENNReal.ofReal τ ≤ θ
